lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: traas mitai jam pa(n)th kee jaas basai man naau ||
lines.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Name shall have no fear on the path of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gat paavahi mat hoi pragaas mahalee paavahi thaau ||
lines.translation: He shall obtain salvation, and his intellect shall be enlightened; he will find his place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਬਨ ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: taahoo sa(n)g na dhan chalai grih joban nah raaj ||
lines.translation: Neither wealth, nor household, nor youth, nor power shall go along with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g simarat rahahu ihai tuhaarai kaaj ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord. This alone shall be of use to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਆਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: taataa kachhoo na hoee hai jau taap nivaarai aap ||
lines.translation: There will be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮਹਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: pratipaalai naanak hamahi aapahi maaee baap ||32||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our Mother and Father. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਘਾਲਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaake bahu bidh ghaalate tripat na trisanaa laath ||
lines.translation: They have grown weary, struggling in all sorts of ways; but they are not satisfied, and their thirst is not quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)ch sa(n)ch saakat mooe naanak maaiaa na saath ||1||
lines.translation: Gathering in and hoarding what they can, the faithless cynics die, O Nanak, but the wealth of Maya does not go with them in the end. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਥਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਊ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਇ ਪਸਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: thathaa thir kooo nahee kaai pasaarahu paav ||
lines.translation: T'HAT'HA: Nothing is permanent - why do you stretch out your feet?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਚ ਬਲ ਛਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਉਪਾਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik ba(n)ch bal chhal karahu maaiaa ek upaav ||
lines.translation: You commit so many fraudulent and deceitful actions as you chase after Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥੈਲੀ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: thailee sa(n)chahu sram karahu thaak parahu gaavaar ||
lines.translation: You work to fill up your bag, you fool, and then you fall down exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤੇ ਅਉਸਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kai kaam na aavaee a(n)te ausar baar ||
lines.translation: But this shall be of no use to you at all at that very last instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: thit paavahu gobid bhajahu sa(n)tah kee sikh lehu ||
lines.translation: You shall find stability only by vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe, and accepting the Teachings of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: preet karahu sad ek siu iaa saachaa asanehu ||
lines.translation: Embrace love for the One Lord forever - this is true love!

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਏਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaran karan karaavano sabh bidh ekai haath ||
lines.translation: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. All ways and means are in His Hands alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਅਨਾਥ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: jit jit laavahu tit tit lagahi naanak ja(n)t anaath ||33||
lines.translation: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; O Nanak, I am just a helpless creature. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਹ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: daasah ek nihaariaa sabh kachh devanahaar ||
lines.translation: His slaves have gazed upon the One Lord, the Giver of everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas simarat rahahi naanak daras adhaar ||1||
lines.translation: They continue to contemplate Him with each and every breath; O Nanak, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is their Support. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਦਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dadaa daataa ek hai sabh kau devanahaar ||
lines.translation: DADDA: The One Lord is the Great Giver; He is the Giver to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: de(n)de tot na aavaee aganat bhare bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: There is no limit to His Giving. His countless warehouses are filled to overflowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੈਨਹਾਰੁ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dainahaar sad jeevanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver is alive forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਿਉ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man moorakh kiu taahi bisaaraa ||
lines.translation: O foolish mind, why have you forgotten Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dos nahee kaahoo kau meetaa ||
lines.translation: No one is at fault, my friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa moh ba(n)dh prabh keetaa ||
lines.translation: God created the bondage of emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: darad nivaarahi jaa ke aape ||
lines.translation: He Himself removes the pains of the Gurmukh;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te te guramukh dhraape ||34||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he is fulfilled. ||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਇਕ ਟੇਕ ਤੂ ਲਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੀ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhar jeeare ik tek too laahi bidaanee aas ||
lines.translation: O my soul, grasp the Support of the One Lord; give up your hopes in others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai kaaraj aavai raas ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਤਉ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhadhaa dhaavat tau mitai sa(n)tasa(n)g hoi baas ||
lines.translation: DHADHA: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur te kirapaa karahu aap tau hoi manahi paragaas ||
lines.translation: If the Lord is Merciful from the very beginning, then one's mind is enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤੇਊ ਸਚ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan saachaa teoo sach saahaa ||
lines.translation: Those who have the true wealth are the true bankers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har poo(n)jee naam bisaahaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is their wealth, and they trade in His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਜਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਤਿਹ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dheeraj jas sobhaa tih baniaa ||
lines.translation: Patience, glory and honor come to those

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam sravan jih suniaa ||
lines.translation: who listen to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jih ghat rahe samaaee ||
lines.translation: That Gurmukh whose heart remains merged with the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tih jan milee vadaaee ||35||
lines.translation: O Nanak, obtains glorious greatness. ||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam naam jap japiaa a(n)tar baahar ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who chants the Naam, and meditates on the Naam with love inwardly and outwardly,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਰਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa narak naahi saadhasa(n)g ||1||
lines.translation: receives the Teachings from the Perfect Guru; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and does not fall into hell. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੰਨਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: na(n)naa narak parahi te naahee ||
lines.translation: NANNA: Those whose minds and bodies are filled with the Naam,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai man tan naam basaahee ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, shall not fall into hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਜਪਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan guramukh jo japate ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who chant the treasure of the Naam,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਖਪਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh maaiaa mahi naa oi khapate ||
lines.translation: are not destroyed by the poison of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੰਨਾਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਤਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: na(n)naakaar na hotaa taa kahu ||
lines.translation: Those who have been given the Mantra of the Naam by the Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam ma(n)tr gur deeno jaa kahu ||
lines.translation: Shall not be turned away.
